why: No row is required, and the record therefore names no driver, no instance and no verdict path: scripts/overlay-verdict-claims.test.mjs refuses a list with no required row that names a driver, so naming one would be the opposite defect.

The reason is not convenience. A required row must name the driver a control-ai-browsers run expression takes to the wave gate, and that driver must return the gate's four readings - toolElements, drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext. Every fact the 4 criteria this milestone declares is written about is a fact about this repository's own field record, the join that reads it and the tests that hold them, against 12 stage(s) of the check chain; none of them is an element's rect or a dev context, so naming a driver would make the gate return a page reading for a claim about the gate.
The portal is not lost by that ruling: each reason names the clause that would have made a row required, and each claim names the suite, the test and the commands that prove it.

capture.reading: an armed run re-derives the list from the intent this checkout binds, its five-column edge coverage, the suites the plan resolves each criterion to and the tests this checkout declares, and writes it only when a value moved; a default run reads the file and asserts it is exactly what this head derives, naming the field that moved when it is not, and the writer refuses a candidate that is not the fixed point of this pin.
